notes.title: V1.0.1.6 Major Art Update
Update V1.0.0.11
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] 【New Feature】New support for 2K and 4K resolutions
[*] 【New Feature】Warrior Artifact, Earthshaker Hammer: When picking up a rune, release a shockwave that stuns nearby enemies for 2 seconds
[*] 【New Feature】Warrior Artifact, Secret Technique: Breath of Thunder: When using an attack card, envelop yourself in lightning, dealing Lightning Damage to nearby enemies and applying Shock
[*] 【Balance Adjustment】Mage attack card, Lightning Strike, damage increased from 100 to 200
[*] 【Balance Adjustment】Mage skill card, Mass Draw, cost increased from 5 to 8
[*] 【Balance Adjustment】Voidwalker's skill card, Summon Golem, changed from granting 50 armor to all allies after attacking 3 times to granting 150 armor to itself
[*] 【Balance Adjustment】Lowered the overall difficulty of Auto Chess Mode
[*] 【Balance Adjustment】Lowered the difficulty of Difficulty Levels 9 and 10 across all modes
[*] 【Bug Fix】Fixed an issue with abnormal save settings
[/olist]
